claim_scores.rationale: Shows valid `openai/gpt-5-mini` setup, asserts `kwargs['max_completion_tokens'] == 16000`, and asserts `max_tokens` is absent.
Demonstrates invalid `openai/gpt-5-mini` config raising `ValueError` and checks the required reasoning-model error substring.
Contrasts with `openai/gpt-5-chat` succeeding, preserving `temperature=0.7`, storing `1000` in `kwargs['max_tokens']`, and omitting `max_completion_tokens`.
